column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Bethel will become trouble (aven)” is rendered “Bethel shall come to nothing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they thrust righteousness down to the ground” is rendered “lay righteousness to rest in the earth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “deep darkness” is rendered “the shadow of death.”
NKJV renders “who makes devastation flash” as “He rains ruin,” and the second “devastation” as “fury”; the meaning of the verb is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “a portion of grain” is rendered “grain taxes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they turn aside the needy in the gate” is rendered “Diverting the poor from justice at the gate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who know lamentation” is rendered “skillful lamenters.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I do not delight (smell)” is rendered “I do not savor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “let it roll on” is rendered “let justice run down,” and “an ever-flowing wadi” “a mighty stream.”
Close to the Hebrew; the future “you will lift up” is rendered as past, “You also carried,” and “Kiyyun” “Chiun.”
